text:
Line 3 of `catalog/members.py`: `# The lending policy allows each member to hold five books at once.`

All 16 tests now pass. The fixes:
- `search.py`: imported `normalize` from `catalog.text` instead of the nonexistent `catalog.nonexistent`.
- `members.py`: set `MAX_BORROWED` to 5 (it was 3).
- `books.py`: `parse_book` now converts `year` to an int.
- `fees.py`: `late_fee` multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE` (it was adding them).
- `inventory.py`: `recent` returns `[-n:]` (it was `[-n - 1:]`, one event too many).
- `factory.py`: added the missing "Emma" book to `sample_books`.
